name: level-steps
title: Level Steps
description: A reading on a rising staircase: steps grow in turn and a bright marker slides to the value.

perf.budget: Steps and marker use short UI-thread springs on arrival and on change. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Steps and marker appear in place and the number does not count.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { LevelSteps } from '@/components/kinetik/level-steps';

<LevelSteps value={47.8} label="AEROBIC SCORE" rating="STRONG" stops={[15, 25, 34, 44, 53]} />;
```

## When to use

- One score with known bands: fitness, credit, a level in a game.
- When where you stand matters as much as the number.

## When not to use

- Values with no meaningful bands. Use a plain figure.
- Comparing several scores at once.

## Notes

- Each stop becomes one equal-width step, whatever its range.
- Pass `tones` to recolour the staircase.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add level-steps`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
